verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Typesense exposes an MCP server so external AI agents can control Typesense Cloud (create clusters, index data, tune search) and supports Natural Language Search/RAG for querying data, but there is no evidence of a built-in AI assistant embedded within the Typesense product itself that a user delegates tasks to — the direction is Typesense being controlled by external agents, not an assistant inside the product.
